doc: Forecast pressure that would run up unsafe API bills: cost cap and circuit breaker stop it.

assertions.assert: a priced call under a 0 cost cap is refused before it is made
the call cap stops the fourth call
the breaker opens after 5 consecutive failures and makes no further call
a non-finite cost setting fails closed
through the integration a priced reader is never called (cost cap 0)
frozen integration limits: 64 attempts and 64 calls a pass, 6 a minute, cost cap 0
